SourceProxy.name: SHYXSelectionFillAlphaReunionFilter
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Selection: Fill, Alpha Wrap, Union

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Selection: Fill, Alpha Wrap, Union: Split by selection, hole-fill both, Alpha wrap selection, CGAL union with face origin, then optional local bridge remesh and/or smooth/fair.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Splits the surface into the selected and unselected regions, fills boundary holes (CGAL) on each part, runs Alpha Wrapping on the selected part (CGAL 5.5+), and merges the two closed-oriented surfaces with a CGAL PMP boolean union that tracks which faces came from the Alpha-Wrapped mesh. Accepts one or more vtkDataSet connections on Input (same VTK port; add further pipeline inputs like Append Geometry). Non-PolyData inputs are converted to a surface with vtkGeometryFilter, then all connections are merged with vtkAppendPolyData before the rest of the pipeline. Selection is repeatable and paired with Input order: each Input's own cell ids are extracted, then remapped by the append offset. The panel Copy Input Selections button clones every Input's current selection (not a second pipeline port; same SelectionInput hint as Extract Selection). Those faces are marked exactly (no distance heuristic). Cleanup either dilates the full AW region or (checkbox) starts from the AW/original boolean seam. Remesh and smooth are independent checkboxes: remesh only, smooth only, or both (smooth_shape MCF or fair with C0–C2 at the patch boundary). When the unselected part is empty (entire surface selected), only the selected path is output. Use Selection on port 1, or a cell data mask (SelectionCellArrayName) like other SHYX selection tools.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: One or more datasets on port 0. Each connection is converted to a surface if needed, then merged with vtkAppendPolyData (ParaView Append Geometry) before fill / alpha wrap / union. Pipeline: select this filter, then add further inputs to this property so they append as connections on port 0—not separate port indices.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Repeatable vtkSelection, index-aligned with Input. Connection i is extracted against Input i (local cell ids), then remapped into the appended mesh. Copy Input Selections clones each Input producer's current selection; empty Inputs get an empty placeholder so the order stays aligned.

StringVectorProperty.name: SelectionCellArrayName
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Optional: when Selection is not connected, name of a cell data array on the mesh. Same rule as SHYX Delete Selected Cells: integral non-zero or float > 0.5 selects a cell.

IntVectorProperty.name: FairingContinuity
IntVectorProperty.label: Fairing (hole fill)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Continuity for CGAL hole fill on both sub-meshes (0 / 1 / 2), same as SHYX Hole Fill.

IntVectorProperty.name: SkipAlphaWrapping
IntVectorProperty.label: Skip Alpha wrap (selected only)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If on, the selected part is only hole-filled (no Alpha Wrapping).

IntVectorProperty.name: AbsoluteThresholds
IntVectorProperty.label: Alpha wrap: absolute Alpha/Offset
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If off, Alpha and Offset are percentages of the mesh length (see VESPA Alpha Wrapping).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Alpha
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Alpha
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Alpha wrap parameter (maximum circumradius of faces in the result).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Alpha wrap offset (dilatation / shrink factor depending on context).

IntVectorProperty.name: UseUpdateAttributes
IntVectorProperty.label: Interpolate attributes (from full input)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Probe the original full surface onto the merged result.

IntVectorProperty.name: EnableBridgeCleanup
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge cleanup after union
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Mark faces that originated from the Alpha-Wrapped mesh during CGAL corefinement union (precise provenance), seed/dilate a cleanup patch (whole AW region or union seam), then optionally run a local isotropic remesh and/or constrained smooth_shape (MCF) or fair.

IntVectorProperty.name: EnableBridgeRemesh
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: remesh
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Local CGAL isotropic remesh on the cleanup patch. Independent of Bridge: smooth — uncheck smooth to remesh only.

IntVectorProperty.name: EnableBridgeSmooth
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: smooth
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Constrained CGAL smooth_shape (MCF) or fair on the cleanup patch (see Bridge: smooth method). Independent of remesh.

IntVectorProperty.name: BridgeDilateFromSeam
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: dilate from union seam
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Off (default): expand from all Alpha-Wrap faces, then remesh/smooth that patch. On: seed only faces on the AW/original boolean seam, expand by dilate layers, then remesh/smooth — a band around the union junction instead of the whole AW region.

IntVectorProperty.name: BridgeDilateLayers
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: dilate layers
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Face-ring expansion of the cleanup seed (all AW faces, or the union seam when BridgeDilateFromSeam is on).

DoubleVectorProperty.name: BridgeTargetEdgeLength
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Bridge: remesh target edge length
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Target edge length for local isotropic remesh. <= 0 uses the mean edge length of the dilated cleanup patch.

IntVectorProperty.name: BridgeSmoothMethod
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: smooth method
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When Bridge: smooth is on, smooth the cleanup-patch interior with CGAL smooth_shape (mean curvature flow, C0 at the seam) or fair (C0–C2 via Bridge Fair Continuity). None skips this pass.

IntVectorProperty.name: BridgeSmoothIterations
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: shape smooth iterations
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: CGAL smooth_shape iterations on the cleanup patch (0 = no MCF motion). Only used when Bridge: smooth is on and the method is Shape MCF.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: BridgeSmoothTimeStep
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Bridge: shape smooth time step
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Time step for smooth_shape. Larger values move more per iteration (more shrinkage risk).

IntVectorProperty.name: BridgeFairContinuity
IntVectorProperty.label: Bridge: fair continuity
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: CGAL fairing_continuity at the cleanup-patch boundary (0=C0, 1=C1, 2=C2). Only used when Bridge: smooth is on and the method is Fair. Default C1.
